decisions.reason: The DPA management tool supports the firm's compliance positioning for agencies, gets positive customer feedback on its templates, and is cheap to maintain alongside the core offer.
The hosting management platform is featured on the home page and is central to the firm's agency-focused strategy, so dropping it is very unlikely.
The configurable managed hosting plan is a core revenue product close to the established business with its own dedicated page.

Extended PHP security support meets real demand from agencies running legacy projects, though its scope may shift as the supported PHP versions age, which makes later changes or a phase-out somewhat more likely.
